propositions: Replace the grandfathered module-size allowlist mechanism with an absolute 800 LOC cap by reading a single-source limit file instead of allowlist/ceilings files.
Add an admin-locked limit mechanism that fetches main's tip via explicit GitHub URL and fails if the limit file value differs from main's cached value, unless main lacks the file (bootstrap case).
Update both gerrit-verify.yaml and test.yml CI workflows to enforce the new absolute cap and limit-lock logic, without reading the allowlist or ceilings files.
Rewrite test_module_size_contract.py to verify the cap is read from the limit file and no src/rebar file exceeds it, and update test_ci_workflow_parity.py to track the new limit file.
The gate must fail with a 'must not be removed' error if the limit file is missing, and warn (not silently skip) if the explicit main fetch fails.
Keep the now-empty allowlist and ceilings files so main's current gate remains green until Phase 2b deletes them.
